reference_sql:
WITH category_promos AS (
  SELECT c.parent_category, COUNT(DISTINCT pp.promo_id) AS n_promotions
  FROM promotion_products pp
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id
  JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  GROUP BY c.parent_category
),
category_units AS (
  SELECT c.parent_category, SUM(ol.quantity) AS promo_units
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  WHERE ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.parent_category
)
SELECT cp.parent_category, cp.n_promotions, COALESCE(cu.promo_units, 0) AS promo_units
FROM category_promos cp
LEFT JOIN category_units cu ON cu.parent_category = cp.parent_category

solver.query:
WITH promos AS (
  SELECT c.parent_category, COUNT(DISTINCT pp.promo_id) AS n_promotions
  FROM promotion_products pp
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id
  JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  GROUP BY c.parent_category
), promo_units AS (
  SELECT c.parent_category, SUM(l.quantity) AS promo_units
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
  JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  WHERE l.promo_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.parent_category
)
SELECT pr.parent_category, pr.n_promotions, COALESCE(pu.promo_units, 0) AS promo_units
FROM promos pr
LEFT JOIN promo_units pu ON pu.parent_category = pr.parent_category
